provenance.notes: Scale values are literals read from source. Control heights are derived (padding + line box) because MUI sets no height on buttons or inputs; each formula is recorded and its inputs are asserted to be present in the source.

densityModes.name: size / dense props per component
densityModes.description: No global density; small|medium(|large) per component and `dense` on lists and menus.

sizes.note: min-height applies below the sm breakpoint; from sm up it is 'auto'

spacing.note: A multiplier, not an enumerated scale.

typography.note: theme.typography.fontSize = 14 (the MD2 default body size); variants are given in px and converted to rem.

elevation.note: 25 levels (0–24) from MD2 elevation: umbra, penumbra and ambient layers.

structure.note: MD2 hue ramps (50–900, A100–A700). Each semantic colour is main/light/dark/contrastText; light and dark are taken from the ramp for defaults or computed from main by tonalOffset 0.2, contrastText by contrastThreshold 3.

algorithm.name: augmentColor
algorithm.description: light = lighten(main, tonalOffset), dark = darken(main, tonalOffset × 1.5), contrastText = white or near-black by WCAG contrast ratio against main.

tokens.name: theme.direction
tokens.note: a flag read by components and by the RTL style plugin; it changes no scale

findings: The only direction datum in the theme is theme.direction ('ltr' by default). @mui/system adds RtlProvider/useRtl (a boolean context). Neither changes a scale; flipping physical properties in generated CSS is left to a plugin the application configures (not part of these packages).
One font stack ("Roboto", "Helvetica", "Arial", sans-serif); no per-language stack, and letter-spacing is applied only when the default family is in use (source comment: it was designed for Roboto).
Line heights are fixed unitless ratios per variant (body1 1.5, body2 1.43, button 1.75, caption 1.66) with no language adjustment. Native inputs are forced to height 1.4375em (23px at 16px).
Density: no theme-level mode. Each component has size small/medium (large on Button) or a `dense` prop (lists, menus, toolbar). Arabic locale files exist in locale/ (strings only).

gaps: Control heights are not tokens (derived). No border-width or focus-ring tokens (focus is a ripple).
No global density mode and no compact/touch theme.
Single radius value, no radius scale.
